api_endpoints.description: Create collection (quick or full schema mode)
Drop collection (atomic; release not required first)
Truncate collection: resets rowCount to 0 while preserving schema, index and load state (NEW route in v2.6.12, handler_v2.go truncateCollection)

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: validated by validateCollectionName (same name rules as elsewhere)

api_endpoints.description: Drop function (json tag quirk: capital-F FunctionName)

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: rows: fieldName/value pairs; pk + vector required per row, dim must match schema

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: boolean expression, e.g. id in [1,2] or scalar filters; id field removed from v2 struct

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: pk value or array of pk values

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: query vector(s); dim must match schema; data binding relaxed from required to optional in v2.6.12 - exactly one of data|ids must be provided

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: NEW v2.6.12: search by primary keys; exactly one of data|ids required; int64 pk accepts int/float64-without-fraction/numeric-string, VarChar pk accepts non-empty string (numbers auto-converted); empty array counts as not provided

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: server injects default 100 when omitted; limit+offset must be within [1,16384]

parameters.name: searchParams.ef
parameters.description: HNSW 查询 ef（searchParams 透传键，REST 层不校验由 segcore/index 层消费；generateSearchParams 透传设计 utils.go:2076-2125）

type_constraints.description: schema.fields[].dataType must be one of the string enum values
schema.fields[].fieldName and dataType are required in FieldSchema
quick mode and full schema mode conflict -> code 1100 invalid parameter
type_constraints.assertion: NOT(dimension set AND schema set) else code==1100

type_constraints.description: data rows must contain primary key and vector fields matching schema; wrong dim -> ErrInvalidInsertData
type_constraints.assertion: each row has pk field AND vector field with dim == schema dim, else error

type_constraints.description: consistencyLevel must be in enum; invalid -> code 1100
type_constraints.assertion: consistencyLevel IN {Strong,Session,Bounded,Eventually,Customized} else code==1100 (message: consistencyLevel can only be [Strong, Session, Bounded, Eventually, Customized], default: Bounded)
sparse vector rows accepted via sparse float vector JSON input format in REST insert

type_constraints.description: BinaryVector dimension must be a multiple of 8
filter is a boolean expression string and is the required delete selector (id removed from v2 struct)
type_constraints.assertion: filter != null AND is valid boolean expr

type_constraints.description: verified: 官方 limitations.md 资源命名规则——字段名须字母或下划线开头，仅含字母/数字/下划线，≤255 字符；insert 时（含动态字段）与 query 时校验应一致（query 侧 parse output field name 已执行该校验）
type_constraints.assertion: field names: ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, length<=255, enforced at insert-time (dynamic fields included)

type_constraints.description: verified: 官方文档——同一 Collection 内 Entities 具有相同属性（字段名/数据类型）；动态字段一旦以某类型建立（如 VARCHAR），后续同字段插入不兼容类型（INT64）应拒绝
type_constraints.assertion: dynamic field type consistency: second insert with incompatible type for established dynamic field -> 1100

type_constraints.description: search input contract (NEW v2.6.12): exactly one of ids (primary key search) or data (vector search) must be provided
type_constraints.assertion: (ids present AND data present) => code==1100 message 'primary keys (ids) and query vectors (data) are mutually exclusive. Please provide either 'ids' or 'data', not both'; (neither present, including ids==[]) => code==1802 message "either 'ids' (for primary key search) or 'data' (for vector search) must be provided"

type_constraints.description: ids type conversion rules (convertIDsToSchemapbIDs): int64 pk fractional id -> 1100; VarChar empty string id -> error; unsupported pk DataType -> error; collection without pk field + ids -> 1100
type_constraints.assertion: int64 pk AND id has fractional part (e.g. 1.5) => code==1100 message 'invalid int64 id at index 0: 1.5 has fractional part'; VarChar pk AND id=='' => error 'empty string id at index %d'; pk DataType not in {Int64, VarChar} => error 'unsupported primary key type: %s'; collection has no primary key field AND ids provided => code==1100 'collection has no primary key field'

type_constraints.description: warmup property family (NEW v2.6.12): create forwards warmup.{scalarField,scalarIndex,vectorField,vectorIndex} from params into collection properties; values restricted to disable|sync
type_constraints.assertion: warmup.{scalarField|scalarIndex|vectorField|vectorIndex} value NOT IN {disable, sync} => code==1100 message 'invalid warmup value for key {key}: invalid warmup policy: {value}, must be 'disable' or 'sync''

type_constraints.description: KNOWN GAP (attack-verify target): bare 'warmup' key at collection level in create params is passed through WITHOUT validation in v2.6.12 - live-confirmed params:{warmup:'bogus'} create returned code 0. Bare warmup is field-level only per alter-path error ('warmup key '%s' is only allowed at field level...')
type_constraints.assertion: create with params:{warmup: <any value>} currently succeeds (code==0) - unvalidated pass-through; treat as suspected Type1_IllegalSuccess candidate, NOT a guaranteed contract

type_constraints.description: ArrayOfVector autoindex metric mapping (v2.6.12): when user does not specify metric_type on an ArrayOfVector field, element-level metrics map to EmbList metrics; Sparse ArrayOfVector without user metric not supported
type_constraints.assertion: metric_type omitted AND field type==ArrayOfVector => autoindex maps COSINE->MAX_SIM_COSINE, L2->MAX_SIM_L2, IP->MAX_SIM_IP, HAMMING->MAX_SIM_HAMMING, JACCARD->MAX_SIM_JACCARD; Sparse ArrayOfVector AND metric_type omitted => not supported (error)

range_constraints.description: topK limit: limit+offset must be in [1, TopKLimit=16384] (quotaAndLimits.limits.topK default 16384)
range_constraints.assertion: 1 <= limit + offset <= 16384 else error 'it should be in range [1, 16384], but got %d'

range_constraints.description: limit default 100 injected by server when omitted
max fields per collection 64 (proxy.maxFieldNum); max vector fields 4 (proxy.maxVectorFieldNum)

state_constraints.description: load on already-loaded collection -> code 104 collection already loaded
search/query on not-loaded collection -> code 101 collection not loaded
describe/get on nonexistent collection -> code 100 collection not found (HTTP 200)
drop is atomic and does not require release first
state_constraints.assertion: drop succeeds from any load state

state_constraints.description: index building is async: create returns immediately; poll describe for state; index not found -> 700
state_constraints.assertion: create returns before build completes; NOT built AND describe => code==700

state_constraints.description: alias state machine: already exist -> 1602; not found -> 1600; alias==collectionName conflict -> 1601
altering warmup properties on a loaded collection is blocked (NEW v2.6.12, distinct message from mmap's)
state_constraints.assertion: collection state==Loaded AND altering warmup props => error ErrCollectionLoaded 'can not alter warmup properties if collection loaded'

state_constraints.description: truncate resets row count to 0 while preserving schema, index and load state (all live-confirmed)
state_constraints.assertion: truncate(collection) success => get_stats rowCount==0 AND describe schema unchanged AND load state unchanged

assertions.description: v2 envelope success code is 0 (merr.Code(nil)), not 200
assertions.expected_behavior: success response is {"code":0,"data":...}; live confirmed collections/list -> {"code":0,"data":[]}
HTTP status 200 with {"code":1802,"message":"missing required parameters, error: ..."}; live confirmed

assertions.description: malformed JSON / wrong content type -> HTTP 200 + code 1801
assertions.expected_behavior: HTTP 200 with {"code":1801,"message":"can only accept json format request, ..."}; live confirmed

assertions.description: HTTP status is 200 for almost ALL business responses including errors; only unknown route gives HTTP 404
assertions.expected_behavior: error discrimination must use JSON code field, not HTTP status; unknown route -> 404 page not found; auth middleware rejections 1800/1400 also non-200

assertions.description: v1 legacy envelope: success code 200 (dual-envelope coexistence)
assertions.expected_behavior: GET /v1/vector/collections -> {"code":200,"data":[]}; but v1 errors use merr codes (POST /v1/vector/collections/create {} -> code 1802)
code 1100, message consistencyLevel can only be [Strong, Session, Bounded, Eventually, Customized], default: Bounded
success: code 0 with insertCount and insertIds

assertions.description: search limit default 100 when omitted (server injects)
assertions.expected_behavior: omitting limit yields up to 100 results (by-design default injection)

assertions.description: ids+data both provided -> 1100 mutual exclusion; neither (or ids:[]) -> 1802
assertions.expected_behavior: both => code 1100 'mutually exclusive... not both'; neither/empty ids => code 1802 'either ids or data must be provided'

assertions.description: ids-only search on loaded collection succeeds, returns ranked hits with distance; annsField only set in search params if non-empty
assertions.expected_behavior: ids-only search => success with hits (id + distance); empty annsField not injected (by-design, changed vs v2.6.10 which always set it)

assertions.description: truncate error paths: nonexistent collection -> 100; missing collectionName -> 1802
assertions.expected_behavior: nonexistent => code 100 'collection not found[database=default][collection=...]'; missing collectionName => code 1802

assertions.description: defaultValue fields now get ValidData auto-filled true and FillWithDefaultValue for upsert missing rows (fillWithValue adaptation, v2.6.12)
assertions.expected_behavior: partial rows omitting a defaultValue column are valid on insert/upsert (by-design)

assertions.description: filter parser (planparserv2 v2.6.12): JSON array literals in 'in [...]' with mixed int/float are unified to floats instead of type-mismatch error; constant-folded bool exprs normalized to AlwaysTrue/AlwaysFalse
assertions.expected_behavior: in [1, 2.5] style mixed arrays are accepted (ints promoted to floats); 1==1 accepted as always-true (by-design promotion, previously errored)

behavioral_contracts.description: v2 RESTful error envelope model (differs from 2.3-era knowledge)
behavioral_contracts.scenario: any /v2/vectordb/* endpoint with business error (missing param 1802, bad JSON 1801, not found 100, invalid param 1100, not loaded 101, already loaded 104, alias 1600/1601/1602, auth 1800/1400)
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: HTTP 200 with {code: <non-zero merr code>, message}; success is HTTP 200 {code:0, data}. Only unknown route -> HTTP 404 'page not found'. Discriminate on JSON code, never HTTP status.

success code 200 (GET /v1/vector/collections -> {code:200,data:[]}); errors use merr codes (create missing required -> 1802). Do not assume a single envelope across v1 and v2 surfaces. /api/v1/* management surface uses commonpb.Status {errorCode, reason} with HTTP 400/500.
after successful create (code 0), has returns {has:true} and describe returns schema; get_load_state reports LoadStateNotLoad until load() called

behavioral_contracts.scenario: insert entities, delete by filter, then query same filter
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: deleted entities no longer returned by query/search after delete succeeds (code 0)

behavioral_contracts.scenario: create -> search (not loaded) -> load -> search -> load again -> release -> search
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: search before load -> code 101; after load -> success; load on loaded -> code 104; after release -> search -> code 101 again

behavioral_contracts.description: v2.6.12 new search-by-primary-keys mode on entities/search
behavioral_contracts.scenario: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/search with ids only (no data) on a loaded collection with Int64 pk
behavioral_contracts.expected_behavior: success, ranked hits with distance; with fractional id 1.5 -> 1100; with both ids and data -> 1100; with neither -> 1802

state_invariants.description: after collections/create succeeds (code 0), the collection is queryable
state_invariants.assertion: create.code==0 => collections/has {has:true} AND collections/list contains name

state_invariants.description: after collections/drop succeeds, the collection does not exist
insert N entities -> row_count reflects N
state_invariants.assertion: insert N rows (code 0) => collections/get_stats row_count increases by N (subject to flush/visibility semantics)

state_invariants.description: upsert by pk replaces entity atomically; subsequent get returns new values
state_invariants.assertion: upsert(pk=X, new values).code==0 => entities/get id=X returns new values

state_invariants.description: index create is async: create.code==0 does not imply index finished building
state_invariants.assertion: indexes/create.code==0 => poll indexes/describe until state finished before searching on that index

state_invariants.description: truncate zeroes rowCount but preserves schema/index/load state
state_invariants.assertion: after successful collections+truncate: get_stats.rowCount == 0 AND collections+describe returns identical schema AND load state unchanged

data_types.name: CollectionReq
data_types.description: v2 create collection request: quick mode (dimension+primaryFieldName+vectorFieldName) or full schema mode; conflicting modes -> 1100

data_types.name: FieldSchema
data_types.description: schema field; dataType string enum covers scalar (Bool/Int8/Int16/Int32/Int64/Float/Double/VarChar/JSON/Array+elementDataType) and vector (FloatVector/BinaryVector/Float16Vector/BFloat16Vector/SparseFloatVector) types

data_types.name: SparseFloatVector
data_types.description: sparse float vector; REST JSON input format {index: value} map per row; 2.6 supports in REST schema creation and insert

data_types.name: Float16Vector
data_types.description: float16 vector type (2.6 REST schema support)

data_types.name: BFloat16Vector
data_types.description: bfloat16 vector type (2.6 REST schema support)

data_types.name: SearchReqV2
data_types.description: v2 search request; searchParams keys are index-type dependent: {nprobe, ef, level, radius, range_filter, search_list}

data_types.name: HybridSearchReq
data_types.description: multi-vector search: search[] SubSearchReq + rerank{strategy,params}; advanced_search and hybrid_search alias the same handler

data_types.name: V2Envelope
data_types.description: v2 response envelope: success {code:0, data}; error {code:<merr>, message}. merr codes: 0 success, 100 collection not found, 101 not loaded, 104 already loaded, 700 index not found, 1100 invalid parameter, 1600/1601/1602 alias errors, 1800 auth, 1801 non-JSON, 1802 missing params

data_types.name: V1Envelope
data_types.description: v1 legacy envelope: success code 200; errors merr codes (1802 etc.); /api/v1 management uses commonpb.Status {errorCode, reason}

data_types.name: IndexParam
data_types.description: index definition: fieldName(required), indexName, metricType, indexType (AUTOINDEX/HNSW/DISKANN/IVF_FLAT/IVF_SQ8/GPU_IVF_*), params {M, efConstruction, nlist}
